name: Motion Lite
tagline: Animated captions for talking-head videos: Anna's AI transcribes and writes them, you tweak, your device exports the MP4.
description:
Motion Lite turns a short talking-head video (up to 60 seconds) into a captioned clip ready for Reels, TikTok or Shorts.

1. Choose a video. It stays on your device; only its speech is sent for transcription.
2. Motion Lite finds where you speak, transcribes each part, and the AI splits it into short punchy captions, picks the word to highlight and writes a headline.
3. Pick a look (Pop, Karaoke or Duo) and watch the preview. Nothing to edit by hand.
4. Extras on Anna: add AI background music in the video's mood (it ducks under your voice). The AI also writes a post caption with hashtags, ready to copy.
5. Export: your own device renders the MP4 with the captions, music and your original sound (about the video's length on a mid-range phone).

Connected to the Anna host: the AI captions, headline and music run through Anna on your Anna credits, with no other account or key. Speech is transcribed by GlianaAI (Whisper on Cloudflare) for free with word-level timing and is not stored; Anna's own speech-to-text is the fallback. Want cuts, motion graphics and styles copied from other videos? The full editor is at motion.glianalabs.com.
